\runin{Document sampling uncertainty.} On single runs that save their predictions, CoLaR-SBR exceeds CoLaR by $56.4$ full-label F1 points. A paired bootstrap of the $100$ test documents ($10{,}000$ resamples) gives a $95\%$ percentile interval of $[49.9, 62.8]$ points for this difference. Documents are resampled together across the two models; span counts are pooled before computing F1. It is noted that this interval is conditional on these two trained models; it does not measure the variation between training runs.
